units.zh: 且物力之數蓋是定差役之法，其大數不在多寡也。
units.en: Property assessment exists to fix corvée obligations—the grand total should not turn on sheer quantity.
units.literal: Moreover property assessment numbers are essentially the method for fixing corvée; the grand total lies not in more or less.

units.zh: 朕恐實有營運富家所當出者，反分與貧者爾。」
units.en: I fear what wealthy traders ought to pay is being shifted onto the poor instead."
units.literal: We fear that what wealthy households with real business operations ought to pay is instead divided among the poor."

units.zh: 章宗大定二十九年六月，命為國信使之副者，免增物力。
units.en: In the sixth month of Zhangzong's twenty-ninth year of Dading, deputies on state embassies were exempted from property assessment increases.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-ninth year of Dading under Zhangzong, those appointed deputy to state envoys were exempted from increased property assessment.

units.zh: 又命農民如有積粟，毋充物力，錢慳之郡，所納錢貨則許折粟帛。
units.en: Farmers with stored grain were exempted from property assessment; cash-poor prefectures could pay in grain or cloth.
units.literal: They also ordered that if farmers had stored grain, it should not count toward property assessment; in cash-scarce prefectures, money payments permitted conversion to grain or cloth.

units.zh: 九月，以曹州河溢，遣馬百祿等推排遭墊溺州縣之貧乏者。
units.en: In the ninth month, after the Cao Prefecture river flooded, Ma Bailu and others were sent to reassess the poor in inundated counties.
units.literal: In the ninth month, because the Cao Prefecture river overflowed, they sent Ma Bailu and others to reassess the poor in flooded prefectures and counties.

units.zh: 明昌元年四月，刑部郎中路伯達等言：「民地已納稅，又通定物力，比之浮財所出差役，是為重並也。」
units.en: In the fourth month of Mingchang's first year, Ministry of Justice Gentleman Lu Boda said: "Land already pays tax, yet property is assessed again alongside floating wealth for corvée—a double burden."
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Mingchang, Ministry of Justice Gentleman Lu Boda and others said: "Commoners' land already pays tax, yet property is also comprehensively fixed—compared with corvée from floating wealth, this is double layering."

units.zh: 遂詳酌民地定物力，減十之二。
units.en: Property assessments on taxed farmland were then reduced by two-tenths.
units.literal: They then carefully weighed fixing property on commoners' land, reducing by two-tenths.

units.zh: 尚書戶部言，中都等路被水，詔委官推排，比舊減錢五千六百餘貫。
units.en: The Ministry of Revenue reported flood damage on the Central Capital route; commissioned reassessment cut assessments by more than 5,600 strings.
units.literal: The Ministry of Revenue reported that the Central Capital route and others suffered flooding; an edict commissioned officials to reassess, reducing money by more than 5,600 strings compared with the old.

units.zh: 明昌三年八月，敕尚書省：「百姓當豐稔之時不務積貯，一遇凶儉輒有阻饑，何法可使民重穀而多積也。」
units.en: In the eighth month of Mingchang's third year an edict to the Department of State Affairs said: "People do not store in good years and starve in bad—what policy will make them value grain and store more?"
units.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Mingchang, an edict to the Department of State Affairs: "When the people are in abundant harvest they do not strive to store; at one encounter with famine they immediately face blocked hunger—what method can make the people value grain and store more?"

units.zh: 宰臣對曰：「二十九年，已詔農民能積粟免充物力。
units.en: Grand councilors replied: "In the twenty-ninth year we already exempted farmers who stored grain from property assessment.
units.literal: Grand councilors replied: "In the twenty-ninth year, it was already decreed that farmers able to store grain were exempt from property assessment.

units.zh: 明昌初，命民之物力與地土通推者，亦減十分之二，此固其術也。」
units.en: At Mingchang's start, joint assessment of property and land was also cut by two-tenths—that is the established method."
units.literal: At the beginning of Mingchang, ordering commoners' property jointly assessed with land also reduced by two-tenths—this is indeed the method."

units.zh: 承安元年，尚書省奏：「是年九月當推排，以有故不克。」
units.en: In Cheng'an's first year the Department of State Affairs reported: "Reassessment was due in the ninth month that year, but could not be completed due to circumstances."
units.literal: In the first year of Cheng'an, the Department of State Affairs reported: "That year reassessment was due in the ninth month, but because of circumstances could not be completed."

units.zh: 詔以冬已深，比事畢恐妨農作，乃權止之。
units.en: The court suspended it, noting that deep winter would make completion harm the spring planting.
units.literal: An edict said winter was already deep; when this finished it would fear harming farm work—so it was temporarily stopped.

units.zh: 二年冬十月，敕令議通檢，宰臣奏曰：「大定二十七年通檢後，距今已十年，舊戶貧弱者眾，儻遲更定，恐致流亡。」
units.en: In the tenth month of the second year the court debated comprehensive inspection; councilors warned: "Ten years after Dading's twenty-seventh-year comprehensive inspection, many old households have grown poor—if revision is delayed, we fear flight and exile."
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter of the second year, an edict ordered discussion of comprehensive inspection; grand councilors reported: "After the twenty-seventh year of Dading comprehensive inspection, it has been ten years; old households poor and weak are many—if revision is delayed, we fear flight and exile."

units.zh: 遂定制，已典賣物業，止隨物推收，析戶異居者許令別籍，戶絕及困弱者減免，新強者詳審增之，止當從實，不必敷足元數。
units.en: Regulations followed: pawned or sold property was reassessed with the asset; split households could register separately; extinct or destitute households were reduced or exempted; newly wealthy were carefully raised—but truthfully, without forcing the old total.
units.literal: Regulations were then fixed: already pawned or sold estates—only follow the property in reassessment; split households living apart permitted separate registers; extinct households and the distressed weak reduced or exempted; newly strong carefully reviewed and increased—only follow truth, need not fill the original total.

units.zh: 邊城被寇之地，皆不必推排。
units.en: Raided frontier districts were exempt from reassessment.
units.literal: Frontier cities and places raided by enemies—all need not undergo reassessment.

units.zh: 於是，令吏部尚書賈執剛、吏部侍郎高汝礪先推排在都兩警巡院，示為諸路法。
units.en: Personnel Director Jia Zhigang and Vice Director Gao Ruli first reassessed the capital's two patrol districts as a model for all routes.
units.literal: Thereupon they ordered Ministry of Personnel Director Jia Zhigang and Vice Director Gao Ruli first to reassess the capital's two patrol districts, showing the model for all routes.

units.zh: 每路差官一員，命提刑司官一員副之。
units.en: Each route received one commissioner with a surveillance official as deputy.
units.literal: Each route dispatched one official, with one surveillance commissioner appointed as deputy.

units.zh: 三年九月，奏十三路籍定推排物力錢二百五十八萬六千七百二貫四百九十文，舊額三百二萬二千七百十八貫九百二十二文，以貧乏除免六十三萬八千一百一十一貫。
units.en: In the ninth month of the third year thirteen routes reported reassessed property money of 2,586,702 strings 490 cash against an old quota of 3,022,718 strings 922 cash, with 638,111 strings exempted for poverty.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, they reported thirteen routes' registered reassessed property money 2,586,702 strings 490 cash, old quota 3,022,718 strings 922 cash, with 638,111 strings exempted for poverty.

units.zh: 除上京，北京、西京路無新強增者，余路計收二十萬二千九十五貫。
units.en: Except the Upper Capital, Beijing, and Western Capital routes, which had no new increases, other routes collected 202,095 strings.
units.literal: Apart from Upper Capital, Beijing, and Western Capital routes with no newly strong increases, other routes totaled collection of 202,095 strings.

units.zh: 泰和二年閏十二月，上以推排時，既問人戶浮財物力，而又勘當比次，期迫事繁，難得其實，敕尚書省，定人戶物力隨時推收法，令自今典賣事產者隨業推收，別置標簿，臨時止拘浮財物力以增減之。
units.en: In Taihe's intercalary twelfth month the emperor noted that reassessment crammed floating wealth, property, and prior rankings into a rushed deadline and ordered the Department of State Affairs to adopt ongoing collection: from then on sales followed the trade, separate registers were kept, and only floating wealth was adjusted at census time.
units.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month of the second year of Taihe, the emperor said that during reassessment, since both floating wealth and property were questioned and prior rankings checked, the deadline pressed and affairs multiplied, hard to obtain truth—he ordered the Department of State Affairs to fix a method of timely reassessment collection for household property: from now pawned or sold estates follow the trade in collection; separate registers set; at the time only floating wealth and property bound for increase or decrease.

units.zh: 泰和四年十二月，上以職官仕于遠方，其家物力有應除而不除者，遂定典賣實業逐時推收，若無浮財營運，應除免者，令本家陳告，集坊村人戶推唱，驗實免之。
units.en: In Taihe's twelfth month of the fourth year, the emperor said officials serving afar often left family property improperly assessed; real estate sales were collected promptly, and families without floating wealth could petition ward and village assemblies for verified exemption.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Taihe, the emperor said officials serving in distant places—their families' property sometimes should be reduced but was not; they fixed pawned or sold real estates for timely collection; if no floating wealth or business operations and should be reduced or exempted, order the family to report, gather ward and village households to announce publicly, verify truth and exempt.

units.zh: 造籍後如無人告，一月內以本官文牒推唱，定標附於籍。
units.en: If no one reported within a month after registration, the official's document was used to announce and mark the register.
units.literal: After registers were made, if no one reported, within one month use the official's document to announce publicly and fix the mark attached to the register.

units.zh: 五年，以西京、北京邊地常罹兵荒，遣使推排之。
units.en: In the fifth year envoys reassessed the Western Capital and Beijing frontiers, often ravaged by war.
units.literal: In the fifth year, because Western Capital and Beijing frontier lands constantly suffered military ravages, envoys were sent to reassess them.

units.zh: 舊大定二十六年所定三十五萬三千餘貫，遂減為二十八萬七千餘貫。
units.en: The Dading twenty-sixth-year figure of over 353,000 strings was cut to over 287,000.
units.literal: The old figure fixed in the twenty-sixth year of Dading of more than 353,000 strings was reduced to more than 287,000 strings.

units.zh: 五年六月，簽南京按察司事李革言：「近制，令人戶推收物力，置簿標題，至通推時，止增新強，銷舊弱，庶得其實。
units.en: In the sixth month of the fifth year Acting Nanjing Surveillance Commissioner Li Ge said: "Recent rules require ongoing property collection on marked registers; at full reassessment only the newly wealthy should rise and the old poor fall—that was the intent.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, Acting Nanjing Surveillance Commissioner Li Ge said: "Recent regulations order households to collect property on registers with headings; at comprehensive reassessment only increase the newly strong and cancel the old weak—perhaps truth can be obtained.

units.zh: 今有司奉行滅裂，恐臨時冗並，卒難詳審，可定期限，立罪以督之。」
units.en: Offices now enforce this negligently; a deadline may pile everything together beyond review—set deadlines and penalties to enforce compliance."
units.literal: Now offices carry them out negligently; we fear at the deadline piling together, suddenly hard to examine in detail—set a time limit and establish penalties to supervise."

units.zh: 遂令自今年十一月一日，令人戶告詣推收標附，至次年二月一日畢，違期不言者坐罪。
units.en: Households were ordered to report for marking from the first day of the eleventh month through the first day of the second month of the following year; late reporting was punishable.
units.literal: They then ordered from this year's eleventh month first day, households to report for collection marking, finished by the second year's second month first day; those not speaking by the deadline were punished.

units.zh: 且令諸處稅務，具稅訖房地，每半月具數申報所屬，違者坐以怠慢輕事之罪。
units.en: Tax offices were to list taxed properties and report every half month; violators faced minor negligence penalties.
units.literal: Moreover they ordered all tax offices to list taxed real estate, every half month report numbers to superiors; violators punished for negligent minor matters.

units.zh: 仍敕物力既隨業，通推時止令定浮財。
units.en: Since property followed occupation, full reassessment was limited to floating wealth.
units.literal: Still decreed that since property follows occupation, at comprehensive reassessment only fix floating wealth.

units.zh: 八 年九月，以吏部尚書賈守謙、知濟南府事蒲察張家奴、莒州刺史完顏百嘉、南京路轉運使宋元吉等十三員，分路同本路按察司官一員，推排諸路。
units.en: In the ninth month of the eighth year thirteen officials including Personnel Director Jia Shouqian, Jinan Prefect Pucha Zhangjianu, Ju Prefecture Inspector Wanyan Baijia, and Nanjing Transport Commissioner Song Yuanji, each with a route surveillance commissioner, reassessed all routes.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year, with Ministry of Personnel Director Jia Shouqian, Jinan Prefect Pucha Zhangjianu, Ju Prefecture Inspector Wanyan Baijia, Nanjing Route Transport Commissioner Song Yuanji and thirteen others, by route together with one surveillance commissioner of each route, they reassessed all routes.

units.zh: 上召至香閣，親諭之曰：「朕選卿等隨路推排，除推收外，其新強消乏戶，雖集眾推唱，然消乏者勿銷不盡，如一戶物力元三百貫，今蠲免二百五十貫猶有未當者。
units.en: The emperor summoned them to the Incense Pavilion and said: "I chose you for route reassessment. Beyond collection, when the newly wealthy and the exhausted are publicly ranked, do not leave the exhausted only partly relieved—if a household owed three hundred strings, exempting two hundred fifty may still be unjust.
units.literal: The emperor summoned them to the Incense Pavilion and personally instructed: "We selected you to reassess by route; apart from collection, for newly strong and exhausted households—though gathering the crowd to announce publicly—the exhausted must not be canceled incompletely; like one household's property originally three hundred strings, now exempted two hundred fifty strings yet still not appropriate.

units.zh: 新強勿添盡，量存其力，如一戶可添三百貫，而止添二百貫之類。
units.en: Do not assess the newly wealthy to the full limit; spare their strength—if three hundred strings are possible, add only two hundred.
units.literal: Do not add to the newly strong to the full limit; measure and preserve their strength—like one household able to add three hundred strings but only adding two hundred strings, such cases.

units.zh: 卿等各宜盡心，一推之後十年利害所關，苟不副所任，罪當不輕也。」
units.en: Each of you must do your utmost—one reassessment governs ten years of welfare; failure will not be lightly punished."
units.literal: Each of you should do your utmost; one reassessment fixes ten years of benefit and harm—if you do not match your charge, punishment should not be light."

units.zh: 時翰林應奉耶律履亦造《乙未曆》。
units.en: At the same time Hanlin Attendant Yelü Lü also devised the Yiwei Calendar.
units.literal: At that time Hanlin Attendant Yelü Lü also devised the "Yiwei Calendar."

units.zh: 二十一年十一月望，太陰虧食，遂命尚書省委禮部員外郎任忠傑與司天曆官驗所食時刻分秒，比校知微、履及見行曆之親疏，以知微曆為親，遂用之。
units.en: In year 21, at the full moon of the eleventh month, the moon was eclipsed; the Ministry ordered Ren Zhongjie of the Rites Bureau and the calendar officers to verify the hour, minute, and second of the eclipse and compare Zhao Zhiwei's, Yelü Lü's, and the current calendar—Zhiwei's proved closer, and his calendar was adopted.
units.literal: Twenty-first year, eleventh month full moon, the moon suffered eclipse; therefore ordered Ministry of Rites Vice Director Ren Zhongjie with calendar officers to verify the hour, minute, and second of the eclipse, compare the closeness of Zhiwei's, Lü's, and the current calendars—Zhiwei's was closer, and it was adopted.

units.zh: 由是占候漸差，乃命司天監趙知微重修《大明曆》，十一年曆成。
units.en: Prognostication and observation drifted apart; Zhao Zhiwei, Director of the Astronomical Directorate, was therefore ordered to revise the Grand Clarity Calendar, and in the eleventh year the calendar was completed.
units.literal: From this prognostication and observation drifted; therefore Zhao Zhiwei, Director of the Astronomical Directorate, was ordered to revise the Grand Clarity Calendar—it was completed in the eleventh year.

units.zh: 河南統軍宗尹遣萬戶孛術魯定方與清臣等領騎兵四千往擊之。
units.en: The Henan Commander-in-Chief Zong Yin dispatched Pusulu Dingfang, commander of ten thousand households, together with Qingchen and others at the head of four thousand horsemen to attack them.
units.literal: The Henan Commander-in-Chief Zong Yin sent the commander of ten thousand households Pusulu Dingfang with Qingchen and others to lead four thousand cavalry to strike them.

units.zh: 平章高琪曰：「小人敢犯，法不行爾，況許之乎？
units.en: Chief Minister Gao Qi said, "Petty people dare to violate the law only because the law is not enforced. How much worse if we permit it?
units.literal: Chief Minister Gao Qi said, "Petty people dare to violate the law only because the law is not enforced. How much worse if we permit it?

units.zh: 今軍未息，而產銀之地皆在外界，不禁則公私指日罄矣！」
units.en: Now the armies have not yet stood down, and all the silver-producing lands are outside our borders. If this is not banned, public and private silver will soon be exhausted!"
units.literal: Now the armies have not yet stood down, and all the silver-producing lands are outside our borders. If this is not banned, public and private silver will soon be exhausted!"

units.zh: 天會十三年三月七日，遣攝太尉皇叔祖大司空昱奉玉冊、玉寶，上尊諡曰文烈皇帝，廟號太宗。
units.en: On the seventh day of the third month, Tianhui 13, the court sent the Acting Grand Mentor, the emperor's grand-uncle Yu, Minister of Works, to present jade registers and seals and confer the posthumous title Emperor Wenlie, with the temple name Taizong.
units.literal: On the seventh day of the third month of the thirteenth year of Tianhui, the Acting Grand Mentor, the emperor's grand-uncle Da Sikong Yu, was dispatched to present jade registers and jade seals and confer the posthumous honorific title Wenlie Emperor, with the temple name Taizong.

units.zh: 丙辰，奉上九代祖妣尊諡廟號，是日百僚上表稱賀。
units.en: On the bingchen day the court presented posthumous titles and temple names for the nine generations of ancestors and consorts; that same day the officials submitted memorials of congratulation.
units.literal: On the bingchen day, posthumous honorific titles and temple names for the nine generations of imperial ancestors and consorts were presented; on that day the hundred officials submitted memorials of congratulation.

units.zh: 御史大夫唐括貢、中丞李晏、刑部尚書兼右諫議大夫完顏守貞等亦皆言不可，上初從之，既而竟用襄議，令有司移報，使明知聖誕之實，特改其日以示優待行人之意。
units.en: The Censor-in-Chief Tangut Gong, Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yan, Minister of Justice and Right Remonstrance Officer Wanyan Shouzhen, and others also all opposed the change. The emperor at first followed them, but in the end adopted Xiang's proposal and ordered the responsible offices to notify the foreign court so that the envoys would know the true sacred birthday and understand that the day had been specially changed to show favor toward traveling envoys.
units.literal: The Censor-in-Chief Tangut Gong, Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yan, Minister of Justice and Right Remonstrance Officer Wanyan Shouzhen and others also all said it could not be done; the emperor at first followed them, but in the end adopted Xiang's proposal, ordering the responsible offices to send notice abroad so that the envoys would clearly know the true sacred birthday and that the day was specially changed to show favor toward traveling envoys.

units.zh: 二年二月，九路提刑馬百祿奏：「聖訓農民有地一頃者區種一畝，五畝即止。
units.en: In the second month of year two, nine-circuit Surveillance Commissioner Ma Bailu memorialized, "The sacred instruction is that farmers with one qing of land should plant one mu by the plot method, stopping at five mu.
units.literal: In the second month of year two, nine-circuit Surveillance Commissioner Ma Bailu memorialized, "The sacred instruction is that farmers with one qing of land should plant one mu by the plot method, stopping at five mu.

units.zh: 臣以為地肥瘠不同，乞不限畝數。」
units.en: I consider that land differs in fertility and barrenness, and ask that the number of mu not be limited."
units.literal: I consider that land differs in fertility and barrenness, and ask that the number of mu not be limited."
